newsitem.title: USA: Tultex sees improved Q4, as estimated.
newsitem.headline: Tultex sees improved Q4, as estimated.

text.p: Tultex Corp said on Thursday it should see improved financial results in the fourth quarter, in line with expectations.
The activewear and licensed sports apparel manufacturer also said it remained cautiously optimistic about the strength of the retail industry and consumer spending for apparel.
Tultex reported third quarter 1996 earnings of $0.43 per share against $0.30 per share in the same quarter last year.

"We are pleased with results achieved in the third quarter," said President and Chief Executive Officer Charles Davies Jr. "Our record net income reflects the continued success of the programs we have put into place to control costs, better manage working capital and improve product mix."
Davies said this third quarter was boosted by strong licensed apparel sales, and that the company was encouraged because its debt level was $10 million lower than last year.
